kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-ram-directory --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --directory-name testDirectoryName --vswitch-id vsw-uf62w3qzt4aigvlcb0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRAMDirectory

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The directory name. The name must be 2 to 255 characters in length and can contain letters and Chinese characters. The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 目录名称。长度为2~255个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文字符开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: directory_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable public network access
parameters.help_zh: 是否开通公网访问功能
parameters.name: enable_internet_access

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to grant local administrator permissions to users who use cloud computers
parameters.help_zh: 是否为使用云电脑的用户赋予本地管理员权限
parameters.name: enable_admin_access

parameters.help_en: The method allowed for connecting to cloud computers
parameters.help_zh: 连接云电脑时允许使用的方式
parameters.name: desktop_access_type

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID. Only one vSwitch can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 交换机ID。目前仅支持配置一个
parameters.name: vswitch_id

DirectoryId.description_en: The ID of the RAM-type directory
